name: The Romance of the Moth and the Flame
source:
"I welcome you all, to the last and final show of the Rosenwood Center Saint Theater! The long-overdue farewell! The Romance of the Moth and the Flame!"

A story of three women whose lives intersect at sharpened angles.

A one-woman show in an empty theater.

A rebuke of the world of mortals.

A tale of love and parting.

Moth x Flame

[From [url=https://cryingrulesactually.itch.io/mothxflame]itch.io[/url]]
